title: Gate Rusher 2
desc: Gate Rusher 2 turns every second into a small decision: the track keeps coming, and the gates in front of you want a number that goes up or a number that goes down. Play Gate Rusher 2 online for free and pick the right opening before the runway disappears. Reading the gate fast is the whole skill, and it is the same muscle you use on a fast slope run.
howto: The run starts immediately, so be ready to steer straight away.
Move left and right to line up with the gate you want to pass through.
Read the numbers on each gate and choose the one that helps you most.
Keep the run alive — clipping a gate ends the attempt.
Try to reach the finish and then beat your own route through it.

controls.action: steer toward the gate you want
steer toward the gate you want

tips: Commit to a gate as soon as you can read it — hesitating splits the difference.
Scan the next set of gates while you are still passing the current one.
Stay near the middle as a default so both gates stay reachable.
On crowded rows, take the safe gate first and optimise later.

faqs.question: What is Gate Rusher 2?
faqs.answer: It is a fast endless runner where you steer through gates that change your score or your size, and correct decisions beat raw speed.

faqs.question: How do you play Gate Rusher 2?
faqs.answer: Steer left and right to line up with the gate you want, then read the numbers before you pass through.

faqs.question: Is Gate Rusher 2 endless?
faqs.answer: It plays like an endless runner with a finish line to chase, so runs are short and repeatable rather than endless.
